text:
elaine: FYI pushed a DB migration + backfill PR that needs quick eyes before I schedule prod. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821

Changes: add weekly_partition col to events, backfill into parquet-backed partitions, then add NOT NULL constraint. Backfill run uses Airflow. Can someone take a look? I want to merge after approvals + green staging backfill.

samir: on it. will review schema + explain plans. probably a 2h look.

maia: quick Q — are we dropping the old partition col immediately or doing a two-step roll? need to know for downstream joins.

elaine: two-step. keep old col for 2w, copy with sync job, then drop. wrote the plan in PR description under "migration strategy".

jon: can review the backfill DAG and the SQL used for rewrite. also pinging @db-bot for runtime IO estimate.

db-bot: db-bot: estimated staging runtime for ~120M rows = ~38 minutes. expect temporary disk +20% during parquet rewrite.

ci-bot: CI: schema-migration-tests failed on mysql8 matrix (test_events_schema_nulls). rerunning.

samir: saw the failing test — looks like mysql default null semantics tripped one fixture. small test fix incoming, should be fast.

maia: I can approve schema once samir's fix lands. want a runbook snippet added for the prod backfill (timeouts, expected IO, rollback).

elaine: will add runbook section and a smoke query to validate row counts post-backfill. plan to schedule prod backfill in maintenance window (Sat 02:00 UTC) if all green.

jon: left an inline comment recommending an index on (weekly_partition, event_time) to speed the backfill query and reduce table scans.

samir: approved (schema).

maia: approved (backfill + ops checklist pending).

elaine: :thumbsup: thanks all — merging once CI is green and @jon confirms index is sufficient. will announce maintenance window in #incidents before running.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed on branch (after rerun).
